architectures.name: Point Element
architectures.principle: single microscopic node u(x,y); linear relaxation control

architectures.name: Two-State Constituent
architectures.principle: two coupled internal nodes u_a, u_b with shared local equilibrium

architectures.name: Three-State Constituent
architectures.principle: triangular microstructure u_a, u_b, u_c; cycle coupling allows internal circulation

architectures.name: Elastic Link Element
architectures.principle: node plus elastic connections to neighbours; internal deformation possible

architectures.name: Oscillator Cell
architectures.principle: local oscillator z(x,y) = r·exp(iφ); neighbour coupling K·(<z>_n − z)

architectures.name: Rotational Cell
architectures.principle: internal rotational DOF θ evolves by neighbour alignment; orientation emerges

architectures.name: Loop Constituent
architectures.principle: closed internal loop (3 nodes x->y->z->x); supports circulating internal state without explicit phase

architectures.name: Dual-Layer Constituent
architectures.principle: fast internal dynamics u_fast + slow structural u_slow; memory emerges from layer separation

architectures.name: Cooperative Cell
architectures.principle: each cell internally computes weighted 9-point neighbourhood response before updating

architectures.name: Unified Microcell
architectures.principle: multi-DOF cell: oscillation (r,φ) + neighbour coupling + reversible storage; no explicit S9 variables

architectures.name: Wrong: Random Internal Topology
architectures.principle: internal node connections randomly reshuffled each step

architectures.name: Wrong: Disconnected Internal Nodes
architectures.principle: internal nodes evolve independently with no internal coupling

architectures.name: Wrong: Over-Connected Constituent
architectures.principle: all internal nodes equally coupled to all others including every neighbour

architectures.name: Wrong: Frozen Internal Architecture
architectures.principle: internal architecture frozen; node state evolves but internal DOFs do not
